template_name: Board Diversity & Diversity Policy — Governance Advisory

tasks.title: Project charter and stakeholder sign-off
tasks.description: Define engagement objectives, scope boundaries, success criteria, indicative timeline, and budget; obtain executive sponsor and board chair sign-off.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Executive sponsor and board chair have countersigned the charter

tasks.title: Stakeholder mapping and engagement plan
tasks.description: Identify and prioritise stakeholders (board chair, nomination committee chair, company secretary, GC/legal, HR, investor relations, major investors) and map influence and interest.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All board-level and governance stakeholders mapped with named owners

tasks.title: Data access and confidentiality agreement
tasks.description: Negotiate and execute a data access agreement covering board composition data, diversity breakdowns, evaluation outputs, and succession candidates; agree ring-fenced access and retention terms.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Agreement signed by sponsor, GC, and engagement lead; scope of permitted data documented

tasks.title: Confidentiality protocol for board data
tasks.description: Define handling, storage, aggregation, and disclosure rules for sensitive board-level data, aligned to UK GDPR and listing-rule disclosure constraints.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Protocol approved by GC; team briefed and acknowledged

tasks.title: Scope definition and engagement risk assessment
tasks.description: Confirm in-scope/out-of-scope boundaries (board diversity vs organisation-wide DEI), assumptions, and constraints; capture the engagement risk baseline.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scope signed off; top risks logged in the risk register

tasks.title: Initial governance assessment
tasks.description: Assess the client's current governance posture: applicable code, listing venue, AGM cycle, committee structure, and existing diversity disclosures.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Applicable code, listing rules, and AGM cycle documented

tasks.title: Kick-off workshop and board sponsor engagement
tasks.description: Run the engagement kick-off with the board sponsor and core team; confirm mandate, ways of working, and access to key informants.
tasks.deliverables: Kick-off minutes and confirmed access list
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sponsor attends; access to chair, nomination chair, and CEO confirmed

tasks.title: RACI matrix and team assembly
tasks.description: Build the RACI matrix across engagement activities and assemble/confirm the engagement team, including any external evaluators or search partners.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RACI approved; all roles filled with named individuals

tasks.title: Communication plan development
tasks.description: Define cadence, channels, and artefacts for internal and client communication, including reporting to the board and nomination committee.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Plan covers board, committee, sponsor, and team touchpoints

tasks.title: Regulatory landscape scan
tasks.description: Scan the current regulatory and reporting landscape applicable to the client (UK Code, Listing Rules, Parker, Hampton-Alexander/FTSE Women Leaders, CSRD/ESRS, SEC) and flag near-term changes.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Applicable obligations and horizon changes documented

tasks.title: Success criteria and KPI baseline definition
tasks.description: Define measurable success criteria and the initial set of KPIs that will track engagement and board diversity outcomes; agree baseline measurement approach.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Success criteria signed off; KPI definitions aligned to kpi_definitions.json

tasks.title: Board composition analysis
tasks.description: Compile and validate the current board composition dataset: directors, gender, ethnicity, age, tenure, skills, independence, nationality, and committee membership.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each director attribute confirmed against at least two sources

tasks.title: Board charter and succession plan review
tasks.description: Review board and committee charters/Terms of Reference and the current succession plan, noting how diversity and refresh are addressed.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gaps in diversity and succession provisions identified

tasks.title: Current diversity policy and prior initiatives review
tasks.description: Review the existing diversity policy and any prior diversity initiatives, including their stated targets, outcomes, and lessons.
tasks.deliverables: Diversity policy review and initiative history
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Policy strengths, gaps, and prior outcomes documented

tasks.title: Nomination committee Terms of Reference review
tasks.description: Assess the nomination committee's Terms of Reference for independence, diversity mandate, process transparency, and reporting.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ToR evaluated against code expectations and best practice

tasks.title: Board evaluation results review
tasks.description: Review the most recent internal and external board evaluation outputs, including findings on effectiveness, dynamics, and diversity.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Key effectiveness and diversity findings extracted and dated

tasks.title: ESG and disclosure report review
tasks.description: Review the latest annual report, ESG/sustainability report, and diversity disclosures for narrative, metrics, and comply-or-explain statements.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Disclosure completeness and tone assessed vs obligations

tasks.title: HR diversity data collection
tasks.description: Collect relevant workforce diversity data and governance people-data (with appropriate aggregation) to contextualise board diversity against the pipeline below the board.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Data collected at agreed aggregation level; quality issues logged

tasks.title: Elite interview with board chair
tasks.description: Conduct a semi-structured elite interview with the board chair on board effectiveness, diversity appetite, succession, and perceived barriers.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Interview completed; transcript coded against the protocol

tasks.title: Elite interview with nomination committee chair
tasks.description: Interview the nomination committee chair on appointment process, criteria, pipeline, and how diversity is considered in selection.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Interview completed; process and diversity criteria documented

tasks.title: Elite interview with CEO
tasks.description: Interview the CEO on executive pipeline, leadership diversity, board-executive dynamics, and commitment to diversity outcomes.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Interview completed; executive perspective captured

tasks.title: Board self-assessment questionnaire
tasks.description: Design and distribute a board self-assessment questionnaire on effectiveness, dynamics, skills, and diversity; collect and prepare responses for analysis.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Response rate meets agreed threshold; results anonymised

tasks.title: UK Corporate Governance Code compliance check
tasks.description: Assess the board's position against the applicable UK Corporate Governance Code provisions, including board balance, diversity, and evaluation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each relevant provision marked compliant, partial, or explain

tasks.title: Parker Review compliance check
tasks.description: Assess compliance with Parker Review ethnic diversity expectations for the company's index positioning.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ethnic diversity position assessed against Parker thresholds

tasks.title: Hampton-Alexander / FTSE Women Leaders compliance check
tasks.description: Assess compliance with FTSE Women Leaders Review (Hampton-Alexander successor) gender targets for board and senior leadership.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Board and leadership gender ratios compared to 40% target

tasks.title: Gender diversity benchmark
tasks.description: Calculate and benchmark board gender diversity against index and peer comparators, including trend over time.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Benchmark method signed off; comparator set documented

tasks.title: Ethnic diversity benchmark (Parker)
tasks.description: Benchmark board ethnic diversity against Parker Review expectations and peer disclosure.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Benchmark reflects Parker thresholds and peer range

tasks.title: Age and tenure analysis
tasks.description: Analyse board age range/average and tenure distribution, including the proportion of directors beyond the 9-year independence presumption.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tenure buckets and independence implications quantified

tasks.title: Skills matrix analysis
tasks.description: Map current board skills and competencies against the agreed skills matrix to identify coverage gaps.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Skills gaps and surpluses identified and prioritised

tasks.title: Cognitive diversity and diversity maturity assessment
tasks.description: Assess cognitive/behavioural diversity using questionnaire data and locate the client on the DEI maturity model (Compliance to Belonging).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Maturity stage assigned with evidence; cognitive profile summarised

tasks.title: Board independence ratio analysis
tasks.description: Calculate the independence ratio and assess compliance with code expectations on board balance and independent representation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Ratio computed; borderline-independence cases flagged

tasks.title: FTSE 350 peer comparison
tasks.description: Compare the board's diversity profile against the FTSE 350 universe using benchmarking data.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Percentile position vs FTSE 350 established for key metrics

tasks.title: FTSE 250 and sector peer comparison
tasks.description: Refine the comparison against the relevant FTSE 250 sub-index and direct sector peers.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Peer set justified; sector-specific gaps identified

tasks.title: Sector-specific benchmarking
tasks.description: Benchmark against sector norms and investor stewardship expectations specific to the client's industry.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sector stewardship expectations reflected

tasks.title: Historical trend analysis
tasks.description: Analyse multi-year trends in board diversity, refresh, and turnover to establish trajectory and momentum.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Trends plotted for at least three reporting periods

tasks.title: Gap analysis against regulatory targets
tasks.description: Quantify gaps against Parker, FTSE Women Leaders, UK Code, and any CSRD/ESRS or SEC obligations; produce a reporting gap analysis.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each obligation gap quantified with size and urgency

tasks.title: Intersectionality analysis (gender x ethnicity)
tasks.description: Combine gender and ethnicity data to assess intersectional representation and avoid single-dimension conclusions.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gender x ethnicity representation mapped; blind spots flagged

tasks.title: Board effectiveness scorecard
tasks.description: Build a board effectiveness scorecard integrating composition, skills, evaluation, and dynamics findings.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scorecard dimensions weighted and signed off

tasks.title: Nomination committee effectiveness review and benchmark report
tasks.description: Review nomination committee effectiveness and consolidate all Phase 2 findings into the diagnostic and benchmark report.
tasks.deliverables: Nomination committee review and benchmark report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report accepted by sponsor; gaps prioritised for design

tasks.title: Diversity policy framework design
tasks.description: Design the overarching diversity policy framework covering scope, principles, governance, targets, and review cadence.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Framework aligns to code, listing rules, and client values

tasks.title: Board appointment policy design
tasks.description: Design the board appointment policy, including criteria, search approach, structured interviews, and the updated board skills matrix.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Policy defines objective criteria and diverse-slate requirements

tasks.title: Nomination committee charter update
tasks.description: Draft updates to the nomination committee charter/Terms of Reference to embed the new process, diversity mandate, and reporting.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Charter reflects diversity mandate and transparent process

tasks.title: Target-setting methodology
tasks.description: Define the target-setting methodology, distinguishing voluntary targets from quotas and setting credible, time-bound, measurable goals.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Methodology justified; targets realistic against appointment cycle

tasks.title: Board evaluation framework design
tasks.description: Design the board evaluation framework covering internal annual review and external triennial review, effectiveness dimensions, and reporting.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Framework meets code requirements and client maturity

tasks.title: Succession planning framework
tasks.description: Design a multi-year succession planning framework for board and chair roles, balancing continuity with diversity and refresh.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Framework maps roles, pipelines, and staggered refresh

tasks.title: Board-ready candidate pipeline design
tasks.description: Design the approach for sourcing and maintaining a pipeline of board-ready diverse candidates.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sourcing channels and pipeline criteria defined

tasks.title: Mentorship programme design
tasks.description: Design a board mentorship programme pairing aspiring directors with experienced board members.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Programme objectives, pairing model, and metrics defined

tasks.title: Sponsorship programme design
tasks.description: Design a sponsorship programme to actively advocate for high-potential candidates into board roles.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sponsor roles, candidates, and accountability defined

tasks.title: Inclusive board culture guidelines
tasks.description: Draft guidelines for inclusive boardroom behaviour, psychological safety, and meeting practices that make diversity effective.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Guidelines address dynamics surfaced in evaluation

tasks.title: Disclosure and reporting framework
tasks.description: Design the disclosure and reporting framework for the annual report and ESG disclosures, including diversity data governance.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Framework meets code, CSRD/ESRS, and SEC requirements

tasks.title: Regulatory compliance roadmap
tasks.description: Translate obligations into a sequenced compliance roadmap with owners, milestones, and evidence requirements.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each obligation mapped to action, owner, and deadline

tasks.title: Recommendation prioritisation and implementation roadmap
tasks.description: Prioritise recommendations by impact, effort, and risk; build the integrated implementation roadmap with sequencing and dependencies.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Roadmap reviewed by legal and sponsor

tasks.title: Board presentation of findings
tasks.description: Present the diagnostic, benchmark, and proposed direction to the full board for awareness and challenge.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Board has reviewed and discussed the findings

tasks.title: Nomination committee workshop
tasks.description: Facilitate a working session with the nomination committee to refine process, charter, and target proposals.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Committee agrees refined process and targets

tasks.title: Leadership team diversity briefing
tasks.description: Brief the executive leadership team on the direction and their role in pipeline and sponsorship.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Leadership understands role and commitments

tasks.title: Shareholder engagement strategy
tasks.description: Develop the strategy for engaging major shareholders and proxy advisors on the diversity direction and targets.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Key shareholders and messages mapped

tasks.title: Investor stewardship alignment
tasks.description: Align proposals with investor stewardship codes and major investor voting policies to anticipate AGM support.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Voting-policy expectations reviewed and addressed

tasks.title: Regulatory body consultation
tasks.description: Where relevant, consult the regulator or relevant review body to validate approach and expectations.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Consultation completed or formally deemed unnecessary

tasks.title: Feedback integration workshop
tasks.description: Consolidate feedback from board, committee, leadership, and investors into the final policy and roadmap.
tasks.deliverables: Integrated feedback log and revised policy
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All material feedback resolved or documented

tasks.title: Policy wording approval
tasks.description: Finalise policy wording and obtain committee and legal sign-off ahead of board adoption.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Policy wording approved by legal and committee

tasks.title: Board effectiveness pilot evaluation
tasks.description: Pilot the new evaluation framework on a subset of dimensions and refine before full rollout.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pilot findings incorporated into framework

tasks.title: Candidate pipeline presentation
tasks.description: Present the candidate pipeline approach and initial sourcing plan to the nomination committee.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Committee endorses sourcing approach

tasks.title: Policy adoption by board and AGM resolution preparation
tasks.description: Secure formal adoption of the diversity policy by board resolution and prepare any AGM resolution materials required.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Policy adopted and minuted; AGM materials lodged

tasks.title: Nomination committee process adoption
tasks.description: Operationalise the new nomination committee process and updated charter in live meetings.
tasks.deliverables: Updated committee process and meeting pack
tasks.acceptance_criteria: New process used in at least one committee meeting

tasks.title: Candidate search and selection support
tasks.description: Support the nomination committee and search firm in running diverse-slate searches for open board seats.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Diverse shortlists produced for open seats

tasks.title: Board appointment cycle alignment
tasks.description: Align recruitment, onboarding, and announcement timing with the board's appointment and AGM cycle.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Timing mapped to AGM and committee cycles

tasks.title: Mentorship programme launch
tasks.description: Launch the board mentorship programme with pairings, materials, and tracking.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pairings confirmed; first sessions scheduled

tasks.title: Sponsorship programme launch
tasks.description: Launch the sponsorship programme with named sponsors, candidates, and commitments.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sponsors and candidates matched with commitments

tasks.title: Board evaluation cycle integration
tasks.description: Integrate the new evaluation framework into the board's annual and triennial evaluation calendar.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Next evaluation cycle scheduled under new framework

tasks.title: Diversity data collection infrastructure
tasks.description: Stand up the data collection infrastructure for board and pipeline diversity metrics, with privacy controls.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: System live; data model and access controls approved

tasks.title: Reporting automation
tasks.description: Automate diversity and board reporting outputs, including dashboard feeds and annual report data packs.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reports generated from validated data pipeline

tasks.title: Internal communication of policy
tasks.description: Communicate the adopted diversity policy internally, including the rationale, targets, and what it means for teams.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Communication issued across agreed channels

tasks.title: External communication (annual report disclosure)
tasks.description: Prepare the external-facing diversity disclosure for the annual report and ESG communications, ensuring it matches internal reality.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Disclosure legally reviewed and consistent with internal data

tasks.title: Culture change initiatives
tasks.description: Initiate culture-change activities (board behaviours, inclusion practices) that make diverse representation effective.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: First wave of initiatives launched with owners

tasks.title: KPI dashboard deployment
tasks.description: Deploy the KPI dashboard with agreed diversity and effectiveness metrics, baselines, and targets.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dashboard verified against kpi_definitions.json

tasks.title: Diversity metrics baseline
tasks.description: Establish and freeze the diversity metrics baseline against which progress is measured.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Baseline signed off and version-controlled

tasks.title: Board diversity scorecard
tasks.description: Operationalise the board diversity scorecard as a recurring monitoring artefact.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scorecard refreshed automatically each period

tasks.title: Target tracking against milestones
tasks.description: Track diversity and roadmap targets against milestones, flagging variance for action.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Variance triggers defined and active

tasks.title: Policy compliance monitoring
tasks.description: Monitor ongoing compliance with the diversity policy and regulatory obligations.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compliance status reported each period

tasks.title: Board effectiveness monitoring
tasks.description: Monitor board effectiveness indicators over time and surface emerging issues.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Indicators trended; deterioration triggers review

tasks.title: Candidate pipeline tracking
tasks.description: Track the diversity, strength, and conversion of the board-ready candidate pipeline.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pipeline diversity ratio monitored against threshold

tasks.title: Retention and turnover analysis
tasks.description: Analyse director retention and turnover, watching for differential attrition among diverse directors.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Differential attrition flagged for action

tasks.title: Glass cliff monitoring indicators
tasks.description: Monitor glass cliff indicators (crisis-conditioned appointments, shrinking board, elevated turnover) and alert on patterns.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Indicators defined and integrated into alerts

tasks.title: Quarterly progress reporting and disclosure support
tasks.description: Produce quarterly progress reports and provide ongoing support to the annual report diversity disclosure.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cadence agreed; first report issued

tasks.title: Annual board effectiveness review
tasks.description: Conduct the annual board effectiveness review under the new framework and report findings.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Review completed; findings shared with board

tasks.title: Policy effectiveness audit
tasks.description: Audit the diversity policy's effectiveness against its stated objectives and targets.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Audit rates policy against objectives with evidence

tasks.title: Stakeholder feedback survey
tasks.description: Run a feedback survey with board, leadership, and governance stakeholders on engagement outcomes.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Response rate meets threshold; themes synthesised

tasks.title: Regulatory change impact assessment
tasks.description: Assess the impact of regulatory changes during and since the engagement on the client's position and roadmap.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Material changes logged with required actions

tasks.title: Roadmap refinement and next-phase recommendation
tasks.description: Refine the multi-year roadmap based on outcomes and recommend the next phase of work.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Roadmap updated; next-phase scope proposed

tasks.title: Lessons learned workshop
tasks.description: Facilitate a lessons-learned workshop with the engagement and client teams to capture what worked and what to change.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Workshop held; actions logged

tasks.title: Engagement close-out report
tasks.description: Produce the engagement close-out report summarising scope, outcomes, residual risks, and handover.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Report accepted by sponsor

tasks.title: Knowledge transfer and client capability handover
tasks.description: Transfer knowledge, tools, and processes to the client's governance team to sustain the work beyond the engagement.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Client team confirms capability to operate independently
